final:
Assumptions, since this is a non-interactive run:
- **Image model:** none was named, so I wrote one general prompt that works in Flux, SDXL, Imagen or GPT-image, plus a Midjourney version.
- **Mine:** it is generic and not named, so the image won't look like a specific real site.
- **Season:** late autumn, with light snow on the far ridges.
- **Format:** 16:9 at eye level from a locked-off camera.

To make compositing easier, the prompt asks for sharp focus throughout, even soft light without hard shadows, a window that isn't blown out, an empty foreground, pulled-out chairs where people would go, and no text, logos or reflections of people.

## FINAL

**Prompt (Flux / SDXL / Imagen / GPT-image):**
```
Empty meeting room in a copper mining company's regional office in the Armenian highlands, present day (2026), photographed as a clean background plate for compositing. No people. Static camera at seated-to-standing eye level (about 130 cm), 35mm lens, straight-on three-quarter view toward a large floor-to-ceiling window on the far wall. Through the window: a huge terraced open-pit copper mine cut into rugged brown-and-ochre mountains, with stepped benches, switchback haul roads, a few distant yellow haul trucks, grey tailings and dust-coloured spoil heaps, and higher ridges dusted with early snow under a flat, heavy overcast sky. Interior: a long matte walnut conference table with eight empty black mesh office chairs, two of them pulled slightly back. On the table are a closed laptop, a few neutral folders, water glasses and a carafe, and a rough chunk of malachite-green and bornite copper ore used as a paperweight. One accent wall is clad in pinkish-apricot Armenian tuff stone. Other walls are light grey plaster. A wall-mounted display is switched off. A framed geological cross-section map has abstract coloured strata and no readable text. Grey felt acoustic ceiling panels, recessed LED lights turned off, grey low-pile carpet tiles, a potted ficus in the corner. Lighting: soft, even, diffuse overcast daylight from the window only, cool neutral white balance around 6000K, gentle falloff into the room, soft shadows with no hard edges. Exterior exposure is balanced so the mine detail stays visible and the window is not blown out. Photorealistic architectural interior photography, deep depth of field with everything sharp from the table to the mine, true verticals, natural muted colours, low contrast, flat neutral grade, high dynamic range, clean uncluttered foreground space, 8K detail, no motion blur.
```

**Negative prompt (SDXL / Flux / SD-based):**
```
people, person, human, figure, silhouette, hands, reflection of people, text, letters, readable signage, logos, watermark, brand names, sunlight, sun rays, hard shadows, lens flare, blown-out window, overexposed sky, bokeh, shallow depth of field, motion blur, fisheye, tilted verticals, wide-angle distortion, HDR halos, oversaturated, cinematic color grade, film grain, vignette, clutter, cartoon, illustration, CGI render look
```

**Midjourney version:**
```
empty corporate meeting room of a copper mining company in the Armenian highlands, 2026, background plate with no people, large window overlooking a vast terraced open-pit copper mine with haul roads, distant yellow haul trucks and snow-dusted brown mountains, heavy flat overcast sky, long walnut conference table with empty black mesh chairs, pinkish Armenian tuff stone accent wall, framed geological strata map with no text, chunk of green copper ore on the table, switched-off wall display, soft even diffuse daylight, balanced window exposure, eye-level 35mm, deep focus, true verticals, muted natural colours, flat neutral grade, photorealistic architectural photography --ar 16:9 --style raw --stylize 50 --no people, person, text, logo, sunlight, lens flare, bokeh, vignette
```

**Settings:**
- **Aspect and resolution:** 16:9, generated at 1920×1080 or larger (Flux at 1536×864 or larger), then upscaled 2× for the plate.
- **SDXL / Flux:** CFG / guidance 4–6 (Flux guidance about 3.5), 30–40 steps, DPM++ 2M Karras sampler.
- **Seed:** lock it once you have a good frame, so you can make matching variants such as a different chair layout.
- **Optional second pass:** inpaint only the window to refine the mine detail, keeping the same seed and lighting description.
